mechanismEvidence.engineIsIdempotent: qa-engine.js is an IIFE that assigns window.KWQA. Re-injecting replaces the object with an identical API surface (keys OK,SEC_WANT,badgeClass,roleAllowed,run,selfTest unchanged) and installs no observer, listener or timer — so N injections behave exactly like one.
mechanismEvidence.noDomDuplication: allWrapped 493, leafWrapped 493, nestedWrappers 0, doubleWrapped 0 in every configuration. The engine does not linkify — it only reads. Only the <script> count grows (1 → 2 → 3), which is the injection itself.
mechanismEvidence.noStateAccumulation: lexiconEntries 7802 and wordPops 1 constant; domNodes grew by exactly 1 per injected script tag.
mechanismEvidence.conclusion: duplicate engine installation cannot produce duplicate findings; the engine holds no mutable per-run state that a second install could corrupt.

incidentalLead.observation: the stability gate's node count for this chapter is 486, while KWQA reports 463 occurrences. 486 is the number of .rw/.de-link wrapper nodes present at gate time, before the popup scaffolding adds its 7 nodes (493 total afterwards). The Phase-15 anomaly reported EXACTLY 486 occurrences.
incidentalLead.interpretation: this makes the Phase-15 reading look like a different QUANTITY being recorded — a gate-time wrapper-node count rather than KWQA's filtered occurrence count — rather than the same quantity measured wrongly. 966 findings is ~2 per node over 486 nodes, consistent with an engine run against a document in an inconsistent mid-initialisation state where nearly every node mismatched.
incidentalLead.status: UNPROVEN LEAD, explicitly not a conclusion. The Phase-15 record was overwritten when that reading was discarded, the value is not reproducible, and no configuration in this phase produced it. Recorded only so the coincidence is not lost.

closure.phase15b2_68: remains UNEXPLAINED. Double injection — same-document, triple, fresh-document sequential, and fresh-document concurrent — all return 463 / 5 with byte-identical finding fingerprints.
closure.reentrancy: already shown in Phase 24 to cause starvation, delay and (under an external reload) lost records — never altered values.
closure.authoritativeMeasurements: the P23 run1, P23 run2 and P24 control full sweeps remain authoritative: 156,299 occurrences / 1,405 findings / 37 HCM / 71 clean.
closure.rationale: no production defect has been demonstrated by this historical anomaly. The engine is idempotent under re-injection; the driver's only characterised defect is starvation under overlap, which loses records rather than corrupting them and is cheap to guard if ever wanted.
